# Miscellaneous markup reference

Timer, style sheet, command, application builder, design-time size, Ref, and Apply.

### Any type

Receiver: any type.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Apply(Action<T> action)` |  | Applies an action to the object. |
| `Ref(out T field)` |  | Captures a reference to the object. |

### ApplicationBuilder

Receiver: `ApplicationBuilder`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `BuildMainWindow(Func<Window> factory)` |  | Sets the main window factory. |
| `OnStartup(Action startup)` | `event Startup` | Sets the callback invoked on the UI thread after the dispatcher is installed and before the main window is shown. |
| `OnStartup(Action<string[]> startup)` | `event Startup` | Sets the callback invoked with the command-line arguments on the UI thread after the dispatcher is installed and before the main window is shown. |
| `ThrowPlatformNotSupported(string message = null)` |  | Throws a PlatformNotSupportedException with an optional custom message. |
| `UseAccent(Accent accent)` |  | Sets the default accent. |
| `UseAccent(Color accentColor)` |  | Sets the default accent to a custom color. |
| `UseMetrics(ThemeMetrics metrics)` |  | Sets the theme metric overrides. |
| `UseSeed(ThemeSeed lightSeed, ThemeSeed darkSeed)` |  | Sets the seed palettes used to generate light/dark themes. |
| `UseTheme(ThemeVariant themeMode)` |  | Sets the default theme mode. |
| `WithShutdownMode(ShutdownMode shutdownMode)` |  | Sets when the run loop ends automatically as windows close. |

### Command

Receiver: `Command`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `BindDescription(ObservableValue<string> source)` | `bind Description` | Binds the command's description to an observable source. |
| `BindIcon(ObservableValue<IconTemplate> source)` | `bind Icon` | Binds the command's default icon presentation to an observable source. |
| `BindText(ObservableValue<string> source)` | `bind Text` | Binds the command's default presentation text to an observable source. |
| `Description(string description)` | `Description` | Sets the sentence saying what running the command does. Material a presenter may use; a tooltip built from a command carries it when the presenter asks for it. |

### DispatcherTimer

Receiver: `DispatcherTimer`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Interval(TimeSpan interval)` | `Interval` | Sets the timer interval. |
| `IntervalMs(int milliseconds)` |  | Sets the timer interval in milliseconds. |
| `OnTick(Action handler)` | `event Tick` | Adds a tick event handler. |
| `Start()` |  | Starts the timer. |
| `Stop()` |  | Stops the timer. |

### StyleSheet

Receiver: `StyleSheet`.

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `With(Style style)` |  | Defines a type-based style rule (Define) and returns the sheet for chaining. |
| `With(string name, Func<Style> factory)` |  | Defines a named style through a factory invoked on first lookup (Define) and returns the sheet for chaining. |
| `WithName(string styleName)` |  | Defines a type-based style rule by style name (Define) and returns the sheet for chaining. |

### FrameworkElement

Receiver: `FrameworkElement` and derived types (`where T : FrameworkElement`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `DesignHeight(double height)` |  | Sets the preferred preview height for this element. A no-op outside preview sessions. |
| `DesignSize(double width, double height)` |  | Sets the preferred preview size for this element. A no-op outside preview sessions. |
| `DesignWidth(double width)` |  | Sets the preferred preview width for this element. A no-op outside preview sessions. |
